------------------------------ MODULE W4Od16m7p0t0 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Procs, MaxDisp

Free == "free"
NoRead == "no_read"

VARIABLES lock, pstate, snap, dispensed

vars == <<lock, pstate, snap, dispensed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ lock \in Procs \union {Free}
    /\ pstate \in [Procs -> {"idle", "trying", "inCS", "crashed"}]
    /\ snap \in [Procs -> Procs \union {Free, NoRead}]
    /\ dispensed \in 0..MaxDisp

Init ==
    /\ lock = Free
    /\ pstate = [p \in Procs |-> "idle"]
    /\ snap = [p \in Procs |-> NoRead]
    /\ dispensed = 0

\* A dispensing process reads the lock register, snapshotting its value.
Read(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "idle"
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "trying"]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![p] = lock]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, dispensed>>

\* Compare-and-swap: the register still reads free (matching the snapshot), so the
\* process installs itself and enters the critical section.
CASAcquire(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "trying"
    /\ snap[p] = Free
    /\ lock = Free
    /\ lock' = p
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "inCS"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, dispensed>>

\* The compare-and-swap fails: the register no longer matches the snapshot or was
\* not free; the process gives up and will retry.
CASRetry(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "trying"
    /\ (snap[p] # Free \/ lock # snap[p])
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, snap, dispensed>>

\* In the critical section, the process dispenses one unit.
Dispense(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "inCS"
    /\ dispensed' = (dispensed + 1) % (MaxDisp + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, pstate, snap>>

\* The process leaves the critical section, resetting the lock register to free.
Release(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "inCS"
    /\ lock' = Free
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, dispensed>>

\* A single process may crash silently, even while holding the lock.
Crash(p) ==
    /\ \A x \in Procs : pstate[x] # "crashed"
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "crashed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, snap, dispensed>>

\* Recovery of a crashed process frees the lock if it was left dangling.
Recover(p) ==
    /\ pstate[p] = "crashed"
    /\ lock' = IF lock = p THEN Free ELSE lock
    /\ pstate' = [pstate EXCEPT ![p] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, dispensed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Procs : Read(p)
    \/ \E p \in Procs : CASAcquire(p)
    \/ \E p \in Procs : CASRetry(p)
    \/ \E p \in Procs : Dispense(p)
    \/ \E p \in Procs : Release(p)
    \/ \E p \in Procs : Crash(p)
    \/ \E p \in Procs : Recover(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion: any process in its critical section is exactly the one the lock
\* register names, so the compare-and-swap discipline lets at most one process into
\* the critical section at a time -- even across a silent crash.
Exclusive ==
    \A p \in Procs : (pstate[p] = "inCS") => (lock = p)

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Procs = {"p1", "p2"}
    MaxDisp = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Exclusive
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser guards its single dispensing head with a
lock register updated by compare-and-swap, so that only one dispensing process is
ever in the critical section at once. The system tolerates one process crashing
silently, even while it holds the lock, by reclaiming a dangling lock on recovery.

A process reads the lock register, snapshotting its value. It then attempts a
compare-and-swap: if the register still reads free, matching its snapshot, it
installs itself as the holder and enters the critical section. If the register no
longer matches the snapshot or was not free, the compare-and-swap fails and the
process gives up to retry. In the critical section the process dispenses one unit,
then leaves, resetting the register to free. A single process may crash silently at
a time, even while holding the lock; on recovery, if the lock was left pointing at
the crashed process, it is freed.

The full set of actions is: read the lock register, acquire via a successful
compare-and-swap, retry after a failed compare-and-swap, dispense in the critical
section, release the lock, crash a process silently, and recover a crashed process.

SAFETY PROPERTY: any process in its critical section is exactly the one the lock
register names, so the compare-and-swap discipline lets at most one process into
the critical section at a time, even across a silent crash.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od12m6p4t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Couriers, Cap

VARIABLES stored, reserved, leases, inflight

vars == <<stored, reserved, leases, inflight>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ stored \in 0..Cap
    /\ reserved \in 0..Cap
    /\ leases \in [Couriers -> {"none", "held", "depositing", "expired"}]
    /\ inflight \in SUBSET Couriers

Init ==
    /\ stored = 0
    /\ reserved = 0
    /\ leases = [c \in Couriers |-> "none"]
    /\ inflight = {}

\* A courier leases a deposit slot, reserving one unit of fridge capacity, only
\* while stored-plus-reserved leaves room.
AcquireLease(c) ==
    /\ leases[c] = "none"
    /\ stored + reserved < Cap
    /\ leases' = [leases EXCEPT ![c] = "held"]
    /\ reserved' = reserved + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stored, inflight>>

\* The courier deposits its unit; the confirmation message is put in flight and may
\* be processed out of order with others.
Deposit(c) ==
    /\ leases[c] = "held"
    /\ leases' = [leases EXCEPT ![c] = "depositing"]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \union {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stored, reserved>>

\* A deposit confirmation is processed (in whatever order it surfaces), converting
\* the reservation into stored stock -- keeping stored-plus-reserved unchanged.
ConfirmDeposit(c) ==
    /\ c \in inflight
    /\ leases[c] = "depositing"
    /\ stored' = stored + 1
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ leases' = [leases EXCEPT ![c] = "none"]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {c}

\* A held (not yet depositing) lease times out at its deadline.
Expire(c) ==
    /\ leases[c] = "held"
    /\ leases' = [leases EXCEPT ![c] = "expired"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stored, reserved, inflight>>

\* An expired lease's reservation is reclaimed, freeing that unit of capacity.
ReclaimExpired(c) ==
    /\ leases[c] = "expired"
    /\ reserved' = reserved - 1
    /\ leases' = [leases EXCEPT ![c] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<stored, inflight>>

\* A stored unit is issued out of the fridge, freeing physical space.
Withdraw ==
    /\ stored > 0
    /\ stored' = stored - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reserved, leases, inflight>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Couriers : AcquireLease(c)
    \/ \E c \in Couriers : Deposit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Couriers : ConfirmDeposit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Couriers : Expire(c)
    \/ \E c \in Couriers : ReclaimExpired(c)
    \/ Withdraw

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity: the units already stored plus the units reserved by live
\* leases never exceed the fridge capacity, so no combination of concurrent leases
\* and out-of-order deposit confirmations can ever overfill the fridge.
WithinCap == stored + reserved <= Cap

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Couriers = {"c1", "c2"}
    Cap = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT WithinCap
nl:
A blood-bank fridge has a bounded storage capacity. Couriers take lease-based
ownership of a deposit slot before adding a unit, and each lease reserves one unit
of capacity so that concurrent couriers cannot together overfill the fridge.
Deposit confirmations travel over a network that may process them out of order.

A courier leases a deposit slot, reserving one unit of capacity, but only while the
units already stored plus those reserved leave genuine room. The courier then
deposits its unit, putting a confirmation message in flight that may be processed
in a different order than others. When a deposit confirmation is processed, the
reservation converts into stored stock, leaving the stored-plus-reserved total
unchanged. A held lease that has not yet begun depositing may time out at its
deadline, and an expired lease's reservation is later reclaimed, freeing that unit
of capacity. Separately, a stored unit may be issued out of the fridge, freeing
physical space.

The full set of actions is: acquire a lease reserving capacity, deposit a unit
(confirmation in flight), process a deposit confirmation out of order, expire a
held lease, reclaim an expired lease's reservation, and withdraw a stored unit.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the units already stored plus the units reserved by live leases
never exceed the fridge capacity, so no combination of concurrent leases and
out-of-order deposit confirmations can ever overfill the fridge.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od13m3p2t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Machines, Total, MaxTerm

NoOne == "no_one"

VARIABLES term, leader, warehouse, machineStock, vended, slow

vars == <<term, leader, warehouse, machineStock, vended, slow>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ leader \in Machines \union {NoOne}
    /\ warehouse \in 0..Total
    /\ machineStock \in 0..Total
    /\ vended \in 0..Total
    /\ slow \in [Machines -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ leader = NoOne
    /\ warehouse = Total
    /\ machineStock = 0
    /\ vended = 0
    /\ slow = [m \in Machines |-> FALSE]

\* A responsive machine wins a failover election under a fresh, higher term and
\* becomes the restock leader.
Elect(m) ==
    /\ ~ slow[m]
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = m
    /\ UNCHANGED <<warehouse, machineStock, vended, slow>>

\* Only a responsive leader may restock: it moves one unit from the central
\* warehouse into the machines.
Restock ==
    /\ leader # NoOne
    /\ ~ slow[leader]
    /\ warehouse > 0
    /\ warehouse' = warehouse - 1
    /\ machineStock' = machineStock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, vended, slow>>

\* Any machine vends a unit to a customer (a sale needs no leader).
Vend ==
    /\ machineStock > 0
    /\ machineStock' = machineStock - 1
    /\ vended' = vended + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, warehouse, slow>>

\* A returned unit is recycled back to the warehouse.
Return ==
    /\ vended > 0
    /\ vended' = vended - 1
    /\ warehouse' = warehouse + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, machineStock, slow>>

\* A machine becomes slow (backlogged) -- not failed, losing no inventory.
Slow(m) ==
    /\ ~ slow[m]
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![m] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, warehouse, machineStock, vended>>

Resume(m) ==
    /\ slow[m]
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, warehouse, machineStock, vended>>

Next ==
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Elect(m)
    \/ Restock
    \/ Vend
    \/ Return
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Slow(m)
    \/ \E m \in Machines : Resume(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: every product unit is always accounted for in exactly one of the
\* three places -- the central warehouse, loaded in the machines, or already vended
\* -- so the network never creates or loses a unit, whatever the leadership churn.
Conserved == warehouse + machineStock + vended = Total

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Machines = {"m1", "m2"}
    Total = 3
    MaxTerm = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
A vending machine network manages a fixed pool of product units, coordinated by a
single restock leader elected among the machines with failover. The network
tolerates a machine that is slow but not failed: a backlogged machine loses no
inventory and simply cannot act until it recovers.

A responsive machine wins a failover election under a fresh, higher term and
becomes the restock leader. Only a responsive leader may restock, moving one unit
from the central warehouse into the machines. Any machine may vend a unit to a
customer, a sale that needs no leader. A returned unit is recycled back into the
warehouse. A machine may become slow, which is not a failure and loses no
inventory, and may later resume.

The full set of actions is: elect a responsive machine as restock leader, restock
one unit from warehouse to machines as the responsive leader, vend a unit, return
a unit to the warehouse, make a machine slow, and resume a slow machine.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every product unit is always accounted for in exactly one of the
three places -- the central warehouse, loaded in the machines, or already vended
-- so the network never creates or loses a unit, whatever the leadership churn.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od19m7p1t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Patrons

VARIABLES reg, confirmed, inflight, snap, reading

vars == <<reg, confirmed, inflight, snap, reading>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ reg \in SUBSET Patrons
    /\ confirmed \in SUBSET Patrons
    /\ inflight \in SUBSET Patrons
    /\ snap \in [Patrons -> SUBSET Patrons]
    /\ reading \in [Patrons -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ reg = {}
    /\ confirmed = {}
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ snap = [p \in Patrons |-> {}]
    /\ reading = [p \in Patrons |-> FALSE]

\* A patron snapshots the shared reservation register before attempting to add
\* itself.
Read(p) ==
    /\ ~ reading[p]
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![p] = reg]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, confirmed, inflight>>

\* Compare-and-swap: the register is unchanged since the snapshot, so the patron
\* adds itself and queues a durable confirmation.
CASAdd(p) ==
    /\ reading[p]
    /\ reg = snap[p]
    /\ p \notin reg
    /\ reg' = reg \union {p}
    /\ inflight' = inflight \union {p}
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<confirmed, snap>>

\* The compare-and-swap fails because the register changed under the patron; it
\* discards the snapshot and will retry.
CASFail(p) ==
    /\ reading[p]
    /\ reg # snap[p]
    /\ reading' = [reading EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, confirmed, inflight, snap>>

\* A queued confirmation is made durable, processed in whatever order it surfaces.
Confirm(p) ==
    /\ p \in inflight
    /\ confirmed' = confirmed \union {p}
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<reg, snap, reading>>

\* A fully-confirmed reservation is cancelled, removed from register and record
\* together.
Cancel(p) ==
    /\ p \in confirmed
    /\ p \notin inflight
    /\ p \in reg
    /\ reg' = reg \ {p}
    /\ confirmed' = confirmed \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inflight, snap, reading>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Read(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : CASAdd(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : CASFail(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Confirm(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Cancel(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: every durably-confirmed reservation is always present in the
\* shared register, so no confirmed update is ever lost from the register that
\* readers see -- even as concurrent compare-and-swaps and out-of-order confirmations
\* interleave.
NoLostUpdate == confirmed \subseteq reg

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Patrons = {"pa", "pb"}
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A library book reservation system keeps a shared reservation register naming the
patrons who currently hold a reservation. Because several patrons act at once and
their requests may be reordered by the network, patrons add themselves to the
register with a compare-and-swap discipline so that no confirmed reservation is
ever lost.

A patron first snapshots the shared register. It then attempts a compare-and-swap:
if the register is unchanged since its snapshot, it adds itself and queues a
durable confirmation. If another patron changed the register in the meantime, the
compare-and-swap fails and the patron discards its snapshot to retry. A queued
confirmation is later made durable, processed in whatever order it surfaces. A
fully-confirmed reservation may be cancelled, which removes the patron from the
register and the durable record together.

The full set of actions is: snapshot the register, add via a successful
compare-and-swap and queue a confirmation, retry after a failed compare-and-swap,
make a queued confirmation durable out of order, and cancel a confirmed
reservation.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every durably-confirmed reservation is always present in the
shared register, so no confirmed update is ever lost from the register that readers
see, even as concurrent compare-and-swaps and out-of-order confirmations
interleave.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od19m2p2t0 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Total

VARIABLES onShelf, onLoan, inTransfer, phase, crashed

vars == <<onShelf, onLoan, inTransfer, phase, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ onShelf \in 0..Total
    /\ onLoan \in 0..Total
    /\ inTransfer \in 0..Total
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "prepared"}
    /\ crashed \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ onShelf = Total
    /\ onLoan = 0
    /\ inTransfer = 0
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ crashed = FALSE

\* Begin a checkout: a book leaves the shelf into the transfer area, opening a
\* two-phase commit (the book is now prepared, held by the coordinator).
BeginCheckout ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ onShelf > 0
    /\ onShelf' = onShelf - 1
    /\ inTransfer' = inTransfer + 1
    /\ phase' = "prepared"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onLoan, crashed>>

\* Commit the checkout: the prepared book moves from transfer into the patron's
\* loan. Requires no participant currently crashed.
CommitCheckout ==
    /\ phase = "prepared"
    /\ ~ crashed
    /\ inTransfer' = inTransfer - 1
    /\ onLoan' = onLoan + 1
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onShelf, crashed>>

\* Abort the checkout: the prepared book is returned from transfer back to the
\* shelf. This is always possible, so a crash never strands the book.
AbortCheckout ==
    /\ phase = "prepared"
    /\ inTransfer' = inTransfer - 1
    /\ onShelf' = onShelf + 1
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onLoan, crashed>>

\* A patron returns a loaned book to the shelf.
ReturnBook ==
    /\ onLoan > 0
    /\ onLoan' = onLoan - 1
    /\ onShelf' = onShelf + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inTransfer, phase, crashed>>

\* A single participant crashes silently.
Crash ==
    /\ ~ crashed
    /\ crashed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onShelf, onLoan, inTransfer, phase>>

\* The crashed participant recovers.
Recover ==
    /\ crashed
    /\ crashed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onShelf, onLoan, inTransfer, phase>>

Next ==
    \/ BeginCheckout
    \/ CommitCheckout
    \/ AbortCheckout
    \/ ReturnBook
    \/ Crash
    \/ Recover

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: every copy of the book is always accounted for in exactly one of
\* the three places -- on the shelf, out on loan, or in the transfer area -- so the
\* two-phase checkout never creates or loses a copy, even if a participant crashes
\* while a transfer is prepared.
Conserved == onShelf + onLoan + inTransfer = Total

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Total = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
A library book reservation system tracks a fixed number of copies of a title,
moving them between the shelf and patrons' loans through a two-phase checkout. The
protocol is designed so that no copy is ever created or lost, even if a participant
crashes silently while a checkout is in progress.

To begin a checkout, a book leaves the shelf into a transfer area, opening a
two-phase commit; the book is now prepared and held by the coordinator. Committing
the checkout moves the prepared book from the transfer area into the patron's loan,
and requires that no participant is currently crashed. Aborting the checkout
instead returns the prepared book from the transfer area back to the shelf, and is
always possible, so a crash never strands the book in transfer. A patron may return
a loaned book to the shelf. A single participant may crash silently and later
recover.

The full set of actions is: begin a checkout moving a book into transfer, commit
the checkout into a loan, abort the checkout back to the shelf, return a loaned
book, crash a participant silently, and recover a crashed participant.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every copy of the book is always accounted for in exactly one of
the three places -- on the shelf, out on loan, or in the transfer area -- so the
two-phase checkout never creates or loses a copy, even if a participant crashes
while a transfer is prepared.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od11m6p0t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Jobs, MaxGen

NoOne == "no_one"
NoGen == 0 - 1

VARIABLES leaseHolder, leaseGen, jstate, jgen, inflight

vars == <<leaseHolder, leaseGen, jstate, jgen, inflight>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ leaseHolder \in Jobs \union {NoOne}
    /\ leaseGen \in 0..MaxGen
    /\ jstate \in [Jobs -> {"idle", "leasing", "printing"}]
    /\ jgen \in [Jobs -> (0..MaxGen) \union {NoGen}]
    /\ inflight \in SUBSET Jobs

Init ==
    /\ leaseHolder = NoOne
    /\ leaseGen = 0
    /\ jstate = [j \in Jobs |-> "idle"]
    /\ jgen = [j \in Jobs |-> NoGen]
    /\ inflight = {}

\* A job requests the printer lease; the grant, stamped with the current lease
\* generation, is put in flight and may be delivered out of order.
RequestLease(j) ==
    /\ jstate[j] = "idle"
    /\ leaseHolder = NoOne
    /\ leaseHolder' = j
    /\ jgen' = [jgen EXCEPT ![j] = leaseGen]
    /\ jstate' = [jstate EXCEPT ![j] = "leasing"]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \union {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED leaseGen

\* A current grant is delivered (in whatever order it surfaces) and the job starts
\* printing on the exclusive lease.
DeliverGrant(j) ==
    /\ j \in inflight
    /\ jgen[j] = leaseGen
    /\ leaseHolder = j
    /\ jstate' = [jstate EXCEPT ![j] = "printing"]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, leaseGen, jgen>>

\* A grant that arrives stale (its generation superseded) is discarded.
DropStaleGrant(j) ==
    /\ j \in inflight
    /\ jgen[j] # leaseGen
    /\ jstate' = [jstate EXCEPT ![j] = "idle"]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {j}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, leaseGen, jgen>>

\* The printing job finishes, releasing the lease and advancing the generation so
\* any lingering old grants become stale.
Finish(j) ==
    /\ jstate[j] = "printing"
    /\ jstate' = [jstate EXCEPT ![j] = "idle"]
    /\ leaseHolder' = NoOne
    /\ leaseGen' = IF leaseGen < MaxGen THEN leaseGen + 1 ELSE leaseGen
    /\ UNCHANGED <<jgen, inflight>>

\* A job gives up a lease it holds before printing (once its grant is not in flight).
ReleaseLeasing(j) ==
    /\ jstate[j] = "leasing"
    /\ j \notin inflight
    /\ jstate' = [jstate EXCEPT ![j] = "idle"]
    /\ leaseHolder' = NoOne
    /\ leaseGen' = IF leaseGen < MaxGen THEN leaseGen + 1 ELSE leaseGen
    /\ UNCHANGED <<jgen, inflight>>

Next ==
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : RequestLease(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : DeliverGrant(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : DropStaleGrant(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : Finish(j)
    \/ \E j \in Jobs : ReleaseLeasing(j)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion via the lease: any job actually printing holds the printer's
\* lease under the current lease generation, so exactly one job can print at a time
\* and a job with a stale (superseded) lease can never print -- even when grant
\* messages are reordered.
PrintingHasCurrentLease ==
    \A j \in Jobs :
        (jstate[j] = "printing") => (leaseHolder = j /\ jgen[j] = leaseGen)

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Jobs = {"j1", "j2"}
    MaxGen = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT PrintingHasCurrentLease
nl:
A print shop job spooler guards a single printer, a critical resource that only one
job may print on at a time. A job takes lease-based ownership of the printer before
printing, and the lease carries a generation number that advances on release so
that a stale lease can never be used. Lease grant messages travel over a network
that may deliver them out of order.

A job requests the printer lease; the grant, stamped with the current lease
generation, is put in flight and may be delivered in a different order than others.
When a current grant is delivered, the job starts printing on its exclusive lease.
A grant that arrives with a superseded generation is stale and is discarded. When
the printing job finishes, it releases the lease and advances the generation, so
any lingering old grants become stale. A job may also give up a lease it holds
before ever printing.

The full set of actions is: request the printer lease (grant put in flight),
deliver a current grant and start printing, discard a stale grant, finish printing
and advance the generation, and release a not-yet-printing lease.

SAFETY PROPERTY: any job actually printing holds the printer's lease under the
current lease generation, so exactly one job can print at a time and a job with a
stale, superseded lease can never print, even when grant messages are reordered.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od7m8p4t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cranes, Slots, Cap

NoOne == "no_one"

VARIABLES rail, slotLock, placed, phase, inflight

vars == <<rail, slotLock, placed, phase, inflight>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ rail \in Cranes \union {NoOne}
    /\ slotLock \in [Slots -> Cranes \union {NoOne}]
    /\ placed \in 0..Cap
    /\ phase \in [Cranes -> {"idle", "onRail", "atSlot"}]
    /\ inflight \in SUBSET Cranes

Init ==
    /\ rail = NoOne
    /\ slotLock = [s \in Slots |-> NoOne]
    /\ placed = 0
    /\ phase = [c \in Cranes |-> "idle"]
    /\ inflight = {}

\* A crane first takes the coarse gantry-rail lock (exclusive, top of the hierarchy).
TakeRail(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "idle"
    /\ rail = NoOne
    /\ rail' = c
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "onRail"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slotLock, placed, inflight>>

\* Holding the rail, the crane takes a fine workspace-slot lock.
TakeSlot(c, sl) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "onRail"
    /\ rail = c
    /\ slotLock[sl] = NoOne
    /\ slotLock' = [slotLock EXCEPT ![sl] = c]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "atSlot"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rail, placed, inflight>>

\* The crane places a container into the yard; the commit message is put in flight
\* and may be processed out of order.
Place(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] = "atSlot"
    /\ c \notin inflight
    /\ inflight' = inflight \union {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rail, slotLock, placed, phase>>

\* A place commit is processed (in whatever order it surfaces), incrementing the
\* yard count only if there is genuine room, and releasing both locks.
ConfirmPlace(c) ==
    /\ c \in inflight
    /\ placed < Cap
    /\ placed' = placed + 1
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {c}
    /\ rail' = IF rail = c THEN NoOne ELSE rail
    /\ slotLock' = [s \in Slots |-> IF slotLock[s] = c THEN NoOne ELSE slotLock[s]]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]

\* A container is retrieved from the yard, freeing capacity.
Retrieve ==
    /\ placed > 0
    /\ placed' = placed - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<rail, slotLock, phase, inflight>>

\* A crane gives up its held locks before committing a placement.
ReleaseEarly(c) ==
    /\ phase[c] \in {"onRail", "atSlot"}
    /\ c \notin inflight
    /\ rail' = IF rail = c THEN NoOne ELSE rail
    /\ slotLock' = [s \in Slots |-> IF slotLock[s] = c THEN NoOne ELSE slotLock[s]]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<placed, inflight>>

Next ==
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : TakeRail(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes, sl \in Slots : TakeSlot(c, sl)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : Place(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : ConfirmPlace(c)
    \/ Retrieve
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : ReleaseEarly(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity: the number of containers placed in the yard never exceeds its
\* capacity, since each placement re-checks for room at its commit -- even when
\* place commits are processed out of order behind the hierarchical locks.
WithinCapacity == placed <= Cap

=============================================================================
nl:
A container-ship crane yard has a bounded number of container spaces. To place a
container, a crane takes hierarchical locks -- first the coarse gantry-rail lock,
then a fine workspace-slot lock -- before committing the placement into the yard.
Place-commit messages travel over a network that may process them out of order, so
the yard is designed never to be overfilled.

A crane first takes the coarse gantry-rail lock, which is exclusive. Holding the
rail, it takes a fine workspace-slot lock. It then places a container into the
yard, putting the commit message in flight, where it may be processed in a
different order than others. When a place commit is processed, the yard count is
incremented only if there is genuine room, and both the rail and slot locks are
released. Separately, a container may be retrieved from the yard, freeing capacity.
A crane may also give up its held locks before committing a placement.

The full set of actions is: take the coarse rail lock, take a fine slot lock,
place a container (commit put in flight), process a place commit out of order under
the capacity check, retrieve a container, and release held locks early.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of containers placed in the yard never exceeds its
capacity, since each placement re-checks for room at its commit, even when place
commits are processed out of order behind the hierarchical locks.

EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Trains, Blocks, Controllers, Quorum, MaxEntry

NoOne == "no_one"
NoTrain == "no_train"
NoBlock == "no_block"
NoGrant == <<NoTrain, NoBlock>>

VARIABLES occupant, granted, requesting, entries

vars == <<occupant, granted, requesting, entries>>

Tally(t, b) == Cardinality({c \in Controllers : granted[c] = <<t, b>>})

TypeOK ==
    /\ occupant \in [Blocks -> Trains \union {NoOne}]
    /\ granted \in [Controllers -> (Trains \union {NoTrain}) \X (Blocks \union {NoBlock})]
    /\ requesting \in SUBSET (Trains \X Blocks)
    /\ entries \in 0..MaxEntry

Init ==
    /\ occupant = [b \in Blocks |-> NoOne]
    /\ granted = [c \in Controllers |-> NoGrant]
    /\ requesting = {}
    /\ entries = 0

\* A train requests entry to a currently-free block.
Request(t, b) ==
    /\ occupant[b] = NoOne
    /\ <<t, b>> \notin requesting
    /\ requesting' = requesting \union {<<t, b>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, granted, entries>>

\* An interlocking controller grants its single vote to a requested train-block claim.
Vote(c, t, b) ==
    /\ <<t, b>> \in requesting
    /\ occupant[b] = NoOne
    /\ granted[c] = NoGrant
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![c] = <<t, b>>]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, requesting, entries>>

\* A train with a quorum of grants for a free block takes exclusive occupancy.
Enter(t, b) ==
    /\ occupant[b] = NoOne
    /\ Tally(t, b) >= Quorum
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![b] = t]
    /\ entries' = (entries + 1) % (MaxEntry + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, requesting>>

\* The occupying train leaves the block, clearing that block's votes and requests.
Leave(b) ==
    /\ occupant[b] # NoOne
    /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![b] = NoOne]
    /\ granted' = [c \in Controllers |->
                     IF granted[c] # NoGrant /\ granted[c][2] = b THEN NoGrant ELSE granted[c]]
    /\ requesting' = {r \in requesting : r[2] # b}
    /\ UNCHANGED entries

\* A controller withdraws its vote.
Withdraw(c) ==
    /\ granted[c] # NoGrant
    /\ occupant[granted[c][2]] = NoOne
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![c] = NoGrant]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<occupant, requesting, entries>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Request(t, b)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers, t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Vote(c, t, b)
    \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : Enter(t, b)
    \/ \E b \in Blocks : Leave(b)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Withdraw(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion via quorum: whichever train exclusively occupies a block was
\* granted it by a quorum of the interlocking controllers, so no train can seize a
\* block without genuine quorum backing and two trains can never occupy one block.
OccupantsBacked ==
    \A b \in Blocks : (occupant[b] # NoOne) => (Tally(occupant[b], b) >= Quorum)

=============================================================================
nl:
A subway signalling block system is run by two independent interlocking instances
that share one common pool of track blocks. Each block is a critical resource that
at most one train may occupy at a time, and entry to a block is decided by quorum
voting among the interlocking controllers, drawn from both instances.

A train requests entry to a currently-free block. An interlocking controller grants
its single vote to a requested train-block claim. A train that has collected a
quorum of grants for a free block takes exclusive occupancy of it. When the
occupying train leaves the block, that block's votes and pending requests are
cleared. A controller may also withdraw its vote, but only while the block it voted
for is still unoccupied, so a granted occupancy never loses its quorum backing.

The full set of actions is: request entry to a free block, grant a controller's
single vote to a train-block claim, enter a block once a quorum is reached, leave a
block and clear its votes and requests, and withdraw a controller's vote from an
unoccupied block.

SAFETY PROPERTY: whichever train exclusively occupies a block was granted it by a
quorum of the interlocking controllers, so no train can seize a block without
genuine quorum backing and two trains can never occupy the same block at once.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od5m0p1t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Players, MaxVer, MaxCap

NoSnap == 0 - 1

Weight(p) == p

RECURSIVE SumOf(_)
SumOf(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN Weight(x) + SumOf(S \ {x})

VARIABLES total, version, applied, snap, capacity

vars == <<total, version, applied, snap, capacity>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ total \in 0..SumOf(Players)
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ applied \in SUBSET Players
    /\ snap \in [Players -> (0..MaxVer) \union {NoSnap}]
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ total = 0
    /\ version = 0
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ snap = [p \in Players |-> NoSnap]
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

\* A player optimistically reads the roster version before attempting to join.
Read(p) ==
    /\ snap[p] = NoSnap
    /\ p \notin applied
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![p] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<total, version, applied, capacity>>

\* The player commits its join only if the version is unchanged since its read
\* (optimistic check) and the roster weight would stay within the current capacity.
Commit(p) ==
    /\ snap[p] = version
    /\ p \notin applied
    /\ total + Weight(p) <= capacity
    /\ total' = total + Weight(p)
    /\ applied' = applied \union {p}
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![p] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

\* If the version moved under it (another join raced ahead), the player discards
\* its stale read and retries.
Retry(p) ==
    /\ snap[p] # NoSnap
    /\ snap[p] # version
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![p] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<total, version, applied, capacity>>

\* A player leaves the roster, subtracting its weight and advancing the version.
Remove(p) ==
    /\ p \in applied
    /\ total' = total - Weight(p)
    /\ applied' = applied \ {p}
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, capacity>>

\* The lobby capacity is re-rated at runtime.
Resize(c) ==
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<total, version, applied, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Players : Read(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Commit(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Retry(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Remove(p)
    \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : Resize(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: the shared roster total always equals exactly the sum of the
\* weights of the players currently on the roster, so no committed join or removal
\* is ever lost or double-counted under the optimistic retries.
NoLostUpdate == total = SumOf(applied)

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Players = {1, 2}
    MaxVer = 3
    MaxCap = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker maintains a shared roster weight, updated by
players joining and leaving. Because several players act at once, joins use
optimistic locking with retry against a version-stamped roster so that no committed
update is ever lost. The lobby's capacity is re-rated at runtime.

A player optimistically reads the roster version before attempting to join. It
commits its join only if the version is unchanged since its read -- the optimistic
check -- and only if its weight would keep the roster within the current capacity;
on commit the weight is added and the version advances. If the version moved under
it because another join raced ahead, the player discards its stale read and
retries. A player may leave the roster, subtracting its weight and advancing the
version. The lobby capacity may be re-rated to a new value at runtime.

The full set of actions is: optimistically read the version, commit a join under
the optimistic and capacity checks, retry after a stale read, remove a player from
the roster, and resize the capacity.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared roster total always equals exactly the sum of the
weights of the players currently on the roster, so no committed join or removal is
ever lost or double-counted under the optimistic retries.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od2m1p3t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS NumRobots, Bins

Robots == 1..NumRobots
NextOf(r) == (r % NumRobots) + 1
NoOne == 0
NoBin == "no_bin"

VARIABLES token, freeBins, assigned, carrying

vars == <<token, freeBins, assigned, carrying>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Robots
    /\ freeBins \in SUBSET Bins
    /\ assigned \in [Bins -> Robots \union {NoOne}]
    /\ carrying \in [Robots -> Bins \union {NoBin}]

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ freeBins = Bins
    /\ assigned = [b \in Bins |-> NoOne]
    /\ carrying = [r \in Robots |-> NoBin]

\* The dispatch token circulates around the ring.
PassToken ==
    /\ token' = NextOf(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<freeBins, assigned, carrying>>

\* Only the token holder claims a free bin: it takes ownership and removes the bin
\* from the free set together.
Claim(b) ==
    /\ b \in freeBins
    /\ assigned[b] = NoOne
    /\ carrying[token] = NoBin
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![b] = token]
    /\ freeBins' = freeBins \ {b}
    /\ carrying' = [carrying EXCEPT ![token] = b]
    /\ UNCHANGED token

\* A carried bin is delivered: ownership clears and the bin returns to the free set.
Complete(b) ==
    /\ assigned[b] # NoOne
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![b] = NoOne]
    /\ freeBins' = freeBins \union {b}
    /\ carrying' = [r \in Robots |-> IF carrying[r] = b THEN NoBin ELSE carrying[r]]
    /\ UNCHANGED token

\* A privileged warehouse admin force-assigns a bin to a robot, removing it from the
\* free set so no other robot can also claim it.
AdminOverride(b, r) ==
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![b] = r]
    /\ freeBins' = freeBins \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, carrying>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E b \in Bins : Claim(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bins : Complete(b)
    \/ \E b \in Bins, r \in Robots : AdminOverride(b, r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation: any bin that is owned by a robot has been removed from the
\* free set, so a bin can never appear free while already assigned -- and thus can
\* never be handed to a second robot.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A b \in Bins : (assigned[b] # NoOne) => (b \notin freeBins)

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS Aircraft

NoOne == "no_one"

VARIABLES runwayLock, prepPhase, prepFor, astate

vars == <<runwayLock, prepPhase, prepFor, astate>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ runwayLock \in Aircraft \union {NoOne}
    /\ prepPhase \in {"idle", "preparing", "prepared"}
    /\ prepFor \in Aircraft \union {NoOne}
    /\ astate \in [Aircraft -> {"waiting", "onRunway"}]

    /\ runwayLock = NoOne
    /\ prepPhase = "idle"
    /\ prepFor = NoOne
    /\ astate = [a \in Aircraft |-> "waiting"]

\* An aircraft requests the runway, opening a two-phase commit on the runway lock.
Request(a) ==
    /\ prepPhase = "idle"
    /\ runwayLock = NoOne
    /\ prepPhase' = "preparing"
    /\ prepFor' = a
    /\ UNCHANGED <<runwayLock, astate>>

\* The runway manager votes to prepare, only while the runway is genuinely free.
Vote(a) ==
    /\ prepPhase = "preparing"
    /\ prepFor = a
    /\ runwayLock = NoOne
    /\ prepPhase' = "prepared"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<runwayLock, prepFor, astate>>

\* Commit grants the runway lock to the prepared aircraft, which moves onto it.
Commit(a) ==
    /\ prepPhase = "prepared"
    /\ prepFor = a
    /\ runwayLock' = a
    /\ astate' = [astate EXCEPT ![a] = "onRunway"]
    /\ prepPhase' = "idle"
    /\ prepFor' = NoOne

\* A prepared or preparing transaction may abort, granting nothing.
Abort ==
    /\ prepPhase \in {"preparing", "prepared"}
    /\ prepPhase' = "idle"
    /\ prepFor' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED <<runwayLock, astate>>

\* The aircraft clears the runway, releasing the lock.

    /\ runwayLock' = NoOne
    /\ astate' = [astate EXCEPT ![a] = "waiting"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prepPhase, prepFor>>

\* The tower chief force-grants the runway to an aircraft, evicting any current
\* holder and cancelling any pending transaction.
AdminOverride(a) ==
    /\ runwayLock' = a
    /\ astate' = [x \in Aircraft |->
                    IF x = a THEN "onRunway"
                    ELSE IF x = runwayLock THEN "waiting"
                    ELSE astate[x]]
    /\ prepPhase' = "idle"
    /\ prepFor' = NoOne

Next ==
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : Request(a)
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : Vote(a)
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : Commit(a)
    \/ Abort
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : Clear(a)
    \/ \E a \in Aircraft : AdminOverride(a)

\* Mutual exclusion: any aircraft recorded as on the runway is exactly the one that
\* holds the runway lock, so the two-phase grant lets at most one aircraft onto the
\* runway at a time -- even across a chief's override.

    \A a \in Aircraft : (astate[a] = "onRunway") => (runwayLock = a)

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od13m8p1t3 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, PerMax

NoOne == "no_one"

VARIABLES coarseLock, fineLock, ledger, committed, slow

vars == <<coarseLock, fineLock, ledger, committed, slow>>

RECURSIVE SumFn(_, _)
SumFn(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumFn(f, S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarseLock \in Nodes \union {NoOne}
    /\ fineLock \in Nodes \union {NoOne}
    /\ ledger \in 0..(Cardinality(Nodes) * PerMax)
    /\ committed \in [Nodes -> 0..PerMax]
    /\ slow \in [Nodes -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
    /\ coarseLock = NoOne
    /\ fineLock = NoOne
    /\ ledger = 0
    /\ committed = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ slow = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]

\* A responsive node takes the coarse region lock (top of the hierarchy).
TakeCoarse(n) ==
    /\ ~ slow[n]
    /\ coarseLock = NoOne
    /\ coarseLock' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fineLock, ledger, committed, slow>>

\* Holding the coarse lock, a responsive node takes the fine machine lock.
TakeFine(n) ==
    /\ ~ slow[n]
    /\ coarseLock = n
    /\ fineLock = NoOne
    /\ fineLock' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, ledger, committed, slow>>

\* Holding both locks, a responsive node commits a sale atomically into both its own
\* committed count and the shared ledger, so a committed sale is never in only one.
CommitSale(n) ==
    /\ ~ slow[n]
    /\ coarseLock = n
    /\ fineLock = n
    /\ committed[n] < PerMax
    /\ ledger' = ledger + 1
    /\ committed' = [committed EXCEPT ![n] = committed[n] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock, slow>>

\* A responsive node releases both locks it holds.
Release(n) ==
    /\ ~ slow[n]
    /\ coarseLock = n
    /\ coarseLock' = NoOne
    /\ fineLock' = IF fineLock = n THEN NoOne ELSE fineLock
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, committed, slow>>

\* A node becomes slow (backlogged) -- not failed, holding onto whatever locks it
\* has until it resumes; nothing committed is lost.
Slow(n) ==
    /\ ~ slow[n]
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock, ledger, committed>>

Resume(n) ==
    /\ slow[n]
    /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarseLock, fineLock, ledger, committed>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : TakeCoarse(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : TakeFine(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : CommitSale(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Release(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Slow(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Resume(n)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: the shared ledger total always equals the sum of every node's
\* own committed sale count, so no committed sale is ever dropped from the ledger --
\* not even while a node is slow and sitting on the hierarchical locks.
NoLostUpdate == ledger = SumFn(committed, Nodes)

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {"n1", "n2"}
    PerMax = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A vending machine network records sales into one shared ledger. To post a sale, a
node takes hierarchical locks -- first a coarse region lock, then a fine machine
lock -- and only then commits the sale, so that no committed sale is ever lost. The
network tolerates a node that is slow but not failed: a backlogged node holds onto
whatever locks it has until it recovers, and nothing committed is lost.

A responsive node takes the coarse region lock, then, holding it, takes the fine
machine lock. Holding both locks, a responsive node commits a sale atomically into
both its own committed count and the shared ledger, so a committed sale is never
recorded in only one. A responsive node releases the locks it holds. A node may
become slow, which is not a failure; it keeps its locks until it resumes.

The full set of actions is: take the coarse region lock, take the fine machine
lock, commit a sale atomically into both counts, release the held locks, make a
node slow, and resume a slow node.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared ledger total always equals the sum of every node's own
committed sale count, so no committed sale is ever dropped from the ledger, not
even while a node is slow and sitting on the hierarchical locks.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od18m9p0t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Controllers, MaxEpoch

NoOne == "no_one"
NoEpoch == 0 - 1

VARIABLES epoch, holder, holderEpoch, cstate

vars == <<epoch, holder, holderEpoch, cstate>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ holder \in Controllers \union {NoOne}
    /\ holderEpoch \in (0..MaxEpoch) \union {NoEpoch}
    /\ cstate \in [Controllers -> {"idle", "holding"}]

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ holderEpoch = NoEpoch
    /\ cstate = [c \in Controllers |-> "idle"]

\* The door network's control configuration is reconfigured under a new epoch; any
\* controller still holding the master session is now on a stale epoch.
Reconfig ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, holderEpoch, cstate>>

\* An idle controller acquires the exclusive master session, stamping it with the
\* current epoch.
Acquire(c) ==
    /\ holder = NoOne
    /\ cstate[c] = "idle"
    /\ holder' = c
    /\ holderEpoch' = epoch
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "holding"]
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

\* A controller holding a stale session (its epoch behind the current one) steps down.
StaleStepDown(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] = "holding"
    /\ holder = c
    /\ holderEpoch # epoch
    /\ holder' = NoOne
    /\ holderEpoch' = NoEpoch
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

\* The current-epoch holder releases the master session.
Release(c) ==
    /\ cstate[c] = "holding"
    /\ holder = c
    /\ holderEpoch = epoch
    /\ holder' = NoOne
    /\ holderEpoch' = NoEpoch
    /\ cstate' = [cstate EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

\* A privileged admin force-grants the master session to a controller at the current
\* epoch, evicting any current holder.
AdminOverride(c) ==
    /\ holder' = c
    /\ holderEpoch' = epoch
    /\ cstate' = [x \in Controllers |->
                    IF x = c THEN "holding"
                    ELSE IF x = holder THEN "idle"
                    ELSE cstate[x]]
    /\ UNCHANGED epoch

Next ==
    \/ Reconfig
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Acquire(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : StaleStepDown(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : Release(c)
    \/ \E c \in Controllers : AdminOverride(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion: any controller that regards itself as holding the master
\* session is exactly the recorded holder, so at most one controller holds the

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od19m7p4t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Patrons, Cap

NoSnap == 0 - 1

VARIABLES count, snap, inflight, held

vars == <<count, snap, inflight, held>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ count \in 0..Cap
    /\ snap \in [Patrons -> (0..Cap) \union {NoSnap}]
    /\ inflight \in SUBSET Patrons
    /\ held \in [Patrons -> {"none", "pending", "confirmed"}]

Init ==
    /\ count = 0
    /\ snap = [p \in Patrons |-> NoSnap]
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ held = [p \in Patrons |-> "none"]

\* A patron snapshots the shared reservation-count register before attempting a hold.
Read(p) ==
    /\ held[p] = "none"
    /\ snap[p] = NoSnap
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![p] = count]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<count, inflight, held>>

\* Compare-and-swap: the register still matches the snapshot, so the patron's hold
\* is put in flight (not yet counted). The commit message may arrive out of order.
CASReserve(p) ==
    /\ snap[p] # NoSnap
    /\ snap[p] = count
    /\ held[p] = "none"
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = "pending"]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \union {p}
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![p] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED count

\* The compare-and-swap fails because the register moved under the patron; retry.
CASFail(p) ==
    /\ snap[p] # NoSnap
    /\ snap[p] # count
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![p] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<count, inflight, held>>

\* A pending hold's commit is processed (in whatever order it surfaces), counted
\* only if there is genuine room under the capacity.
ConfirmReserve(p) ==
    /\ p \in inflight
    /\ count < Cap
    /\ count' = count + 1
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = "confirmed"]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

\* If there is no room by the time the commit is processed, the hold is rejected.
RejectReserve(p) ==
    /\ p \in inflight
    /\ count >= Cap
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = "none"]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<count, snap>>

\* A confirmed hold is cancelled, freeing one unit of capacity.
Cancel(p) ==
    /\ held[p] = "confirmed"
    /\ count' = count - 1
    /\ held' = [held EXCEPT ![p] = "none"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, inflight>>

Next ==
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Read(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : CASReserve(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : CASFail(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : ConfirmReserve(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : RejectReserve(p)
    \/ \E p \in Patrons : Cancel(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity: the number of confirmed reservations in the register never
\* exceeds the capacity, since every commit re-checks for room -- even as concurrent
\* compare-and-swaps and out-of-order commit messages interleave.
WithinCapacity == count <= Cap

=============================================================================

may have. Patrons place holds by updating a shared reservation-count register with

A patron snapshots the shared reservation-count register before attempting a hold.
On a compare-and-swap that still matches the snapshot, the patron's hold is put in

pending hold's commit is processed, it is counted only if there is genuine room
under the capacity; if there is no room by the time it is processed, the hold is
rejected. A confirmed hold may be cancelled, freeing one unit of capacity.

The full set of actions is: snapshot the register, put a hold in flight via a
successful compare-and-swap, retry after a failed compare-and-swap, confirm a hold
under the capacity check out of order, reject a hold when full, and cancel a
confirmed hold.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od3m4p2t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Banks, Total, MaxQueue

RECURSIVE SumFn(_, _)
SumFn(f, S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumFn(f, S \ {x})

VARIABLES balance, inTransit, queue, inflight

vars == <<balance, inTransit, queue, inflight>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ balance \in [Banks -> 0..Total]
    /\ inTransit \in 0..Total
    /\ queue \in SUBSET (Banks \X Banks)
    /\ inflight \in SUBSET (Banks \X Banks)

Init ==
    /\ balance = [b \in Banks |-> IF b = CHOOSE x \in Banks : TRUE THEN Total ELSE 0]
    /\ inTransit = 0
    /\ queue = {}
    /\ inflight = {}

\* A settlement instruction is submitted to the shared batch queue; backpressure
\* blocks the submission when the queue is full.
Submit(f, t) ==
    /\ f # t
    /\ <<f, t>> \notin queue
    /\ Cardinality(queue) < MaxQueue
    /\ queue' = queue \union {<<f, t>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, inTransit, inflight>>

\* Either settlement engine debits the source bank, moving funds into transit.
Debit(f, t) ==
    /\ <<f, t>> \in queue
    /\ balance[f] > 0
    /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![f] = balance[f] - 1]
    /\ inTransit' = inTransit + 1
    /\ queue' = queue \ {<<f, t>>}
    /\ inflight' = inflight \union {<<f, t>>}

\* The matching credit completes the settlement, moving funds from transit into the
\* destination bank.
Credit(f, t) ==
    /\ <<f, t>> \in inflight
    /\ inTransit' = inTransit - 1
    /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![t] = balance[t] + 1]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {<<f, t>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED queue

\* A still-queued instruction is cancelled before any funds move.
Cancel(f, t) ==
    /\ <<f, t>> \in queue
    /\ queue' = queue \ {<<f, t>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, inTransit, inflight>>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Banks, t \in Banks : Submit(f, t)
    \/ \E f \in Banks, t \in Banks : Debit(f, t)
    \/ \E f \in Banks, t \in Banks : Credit(f, t)
    \/ \E f \in Banks, t \in Banks : Cancel(f, t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: the funds held across all banks plus the funds currently in transit
\* between them always equal the fixed total the batch started with, so interbank
\* settlement neither creates nor destroys money.
Conserved == SumFn(balance, Banks) + inTransit = Total

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Banks = {"a", "b"}
    Total = 3
    MaxQueue = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT Conserved
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch moves a fixed pool of funds between banks. Two
independent settlement engines share one common batch queue and the shared pool of
funds. Settlement instructions are held in a bounded work queue with backpressure,
and each settlement runs as a debit-then-credit so that money is never created or
destroyed.

A settlement instruction is submitted to the shared batch queue; when the queue is
already full, backpressure blocks the submission. Either settlement engine debits
the source bank, moving one unit of funds from that bank into transit. The matching
credit then completes the settlement, moving the unit from transit into the
destination bank. A still-queued instruction may instead be cancelled before any
funds move.

The full set of actions is: submit an instruction under backpressure, debit the
source bank into transit, credit the destination bank from transit, and cancel a
queued instruction.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the funds held across all banks plus the funds currently in
transit between them always equal the fixed total the batch started with, so
interbank settlement neither creates nor destroys money.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od12m7p3t0 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Recipients, Units

NoOne == "no_one"
NoUnit == "no_unit"

VARIABLES owner, target, snap, rstate

vars == <<owner, target, snap, rstate>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ owner \in [Units -> Recipients \union {NoOne}]
    /\ target \in [Recipients -> Units \union {NoUnit}]
    /\ snap \in [Recipients -> Recipients \union {NoOne}]
    /\ rstate \in [Recipients -> {"idle", "ready", "holding", "crashed"}]

Init ==
    /\ owner = [u \in Units |-> NoOne]
    /\ target = [r \in Recipients |-> NoUnit]
    /\ snap = [r \in Recipients |-> NoOne]
    /\ rstate = [r \in Recipients |-> "idle"]

\* A recipient targets a blood unit and snapshots that unit's owner register.
Read(r, u) ==
    /\ rstate[r] = "idle"
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![r] = u]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![r] = owner[u]]
    /\ rstate' = [rstate EXCEPT ![r] = "ready"]
    /\ UNCHANGED owner

\* Compare-and-swap: the unit's register still reads free (matching the snapshot),
\* so the recipient installs itself as owner and holds the unit.
CASClaim(r) ==
    /\ rstate[r] = "ready"
    /\ snap[r] = NoOne
    /\ owner[target[r]] = NoOne
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![target[r]] = r]
    /\ rstate' = [rstate EXCEPT ![r] = "holding"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<target, snap>>

\* The compare-and-swap fails: the unit was not free, or its register moved under
\* the recipient; it gives up to retry.
CASFail(r) ==
    /\ rstate[r] = "ready"
    /\ (snap[r] # NoOne \/ owner[target[r]] # snap[r])
    /\ rstate' = [rstate EXCEPT ![r] = "idle"]
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![r] = NoUnit]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, snap>>

\* The recipient releases the unit it holds.
Release(r) ==
    /\ rstate[r] = "holding"
    /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![target[r]] = NoOne]
    /\ rstate' = [rstate EXCEPT ![r] = "idle"]
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![r] = NoUnit]
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

\* A single recipient crashes silently, even while holding a unit.
Crash(r) ==
    /\ \A x \in Recipients : rstate[x] # "crashed"
    /\ rstate' = [rstate EXCEPT ![r] = "crashed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, target, snap>>

\* Recovery frees any unit left owned by the crashed recipient.
Recover(r) ==
    /\ rstate[r] = "crashed"
    /\ owner' = [u \in Units |-> IF owner[u] = r THEN NoOne ELSE owner[u]]
    /\ rstate' = [rstate EXCEPT ![r] = "idle"]
    /\ target' = [target EXCEPT ![r] = NoUnit]
    /\ UNCHANGED snap

Next ==
    \/ \E r \in Recipients, u \in Units : Read(r, u)
    \/ \E r \in Recipients : CASClaim(r)
    \/ \E r \in Recipients : CASFail(r)
    \/ \E r \in Recipients : Release(r)
    \/ \E r \in Recipients : Crash(r)
    \/ \E r \in Recipients : Recover(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation: any recipient that holds a unit is exactly the one the
\* unit's owner register names, so the compare-and-swap discipline never lets two
\* recipients hold the same blood unit -- even across a silent crash.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A r \in Recipients : (rstate[r] = "holding") => (owner[target[r]] = r)

=============================================================================
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker allocates individual blood units to recipients. Each
unit has an owner register, and recipients claim units with a compare-and-swap
discipline so that a unit is never allocated to two recipients at once. The system
tolerates one recipient's request handler crashing silently, freeing any unit it
held on recovery.

A recipient targets a blood unit and snapshots that unit's owner register. It then
attempts a compare-and-swap: if the register still reads free, matching its
snapshot, it installs itself as owner and holds the unit. If the unit was not free
or its register moved under the recipient, the compare-and-swap fails and the
recipient retries. A recipient releases the unit it holds. A single recipient may
crash silently at a time, even while holding a unit; on recovery, any unit still
owned by the crashed recipient is freed.

The full set of actions is: target a unit and snapshot its register, claim via a
successful compare-and-swap, retry after a failed compare-and-swap, release a held
unit, crash a recipient silently, and recover a crashed recipient.

SAFETY PROPERTY: any recipient that holds a unit is exactly the one the unit's owner
register names, so the compare-and-swap discipline never lets two recipients hold
the same blood unit, even across a silent crash.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od0m5p3t5 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Members, Surgeries, Slots, Quorum

NoOne == "no_one"
NoSurg == "no_surg"
NoSlot == "no_slot"
NoGrant == <<NoSurg, NoSlot>>

VARIABLES assigned, granted, byAdmin, requesting

vars == <<assigned, granted, byAdmin, requesting>>

Tally(s, sl) == Cardinality({m \in Members : granted[m] = <<s, sl>>})

TypeOK ==
    /\ assigned \in [Slots -> Surgeries \union {NoOne}]
    /\ granted \in [Members -> (Surgeries \union {NoSurg}) \X (Slots \union {NoSlot})]
    /\ byAdmin \in [Slots -> BOOLEAN]
    /\ requesting \in SUBSET (Surgeries \X Slots)

Init ==
    /\ assigned = [sl \in Slots |-> NoOne]
    /\ granted = [m \in Members |-> NoGrant]
    /\ byAdmin = [sl \in Slots |-> FALSE]
    /\ requesting = {}

\* A surgery requests a currently-free OR slot.
Request(s, sl) ==
    /\ assigned[sl] = NoOne
    /\ <<s, sl>> \notin requesting
    /\ requesting' = requesting \union {<<s, sl>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assigned, granted, byAdmin>>

\* A committee member grants its single vote to a requested surgery-slot claim.
Vote(m, s, sl) ==
    /\ <<s, sl>> \in requesting
    /\ assigned[sl] = NoOne
    /\ granted[m] = NoGrant
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![m] = <<s, sl>>]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assigned, byAdmin, requesting>>

\* A surgery with a quorum of grants for a free slot is assigned it (normal path).
Assign(s, sl) ==
    /\ assigned[sl] = NoOne
    /\ Tally(s, sl) >= Quorum
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![sl] = s]
    /\ byAdmin' = [byAdmin EXCEPT ![sl] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, requesting>>

\* The chief of surgery force-assigns a slot, bypassing the quorum (privileged path).
AdminOverride(s, sl) ==
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![sl] = s]
    /\ byAdmin' = [byAdmin EXCEPT ![sl] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, requesting>>

\* A slot is vacated, clearing its assignment and its votes and requests.
Vacate(sl) ==
    /\ assigned[sl] # NoOne
    /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![sl] = NoOne]
    /\ byAdmin' = [byAdmin EXCEPT ![sl] = FALSE]
    /\ granted' = [m \in Members |->
                     IF granted[m] # NoGrant /\ granted[m][2] = sl THEN NoGrant ELSE granted[m]]
    /\ requesting' = {r \in requesting : r[2] # sl}

\* A member withdraws its vote, only while the voted slot is still unassigned.
Withdraw(m) ==
    /\ granted[m] # NoGrant
    /\ assigned[granted[m][2]] = NoOne
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![m] = NoGrant]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<assigned, byAdmin, requesting>>

Next ==
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries, sl \in Slots : Request(s, sl)
    \/ \E m \in Members, s \in Surgeries, sl \in Slots : Vote(m, s, sl)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries, sl \in Slots : Assign(s, sl)
    \/ \E s \in Surgeries, sl \in Slots : AdminOverride(s, sl)
    \/ \E sl \in Slots : Vacate(sl)
    \/ \E m \in Members : Withdraw(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation via quorum: any slot assigned through the normal path holds a
\* quorum of committee grants for the surgery it was assigned to, so two surgeries
\* can never both win the same slot (only a chief's override is exempt).
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A sl \in Slots :
        (assigned[sl] # NoOne /\ ~ byAdmin[sl]) => (Tally(assigned[sl], sl) >= Quorum)

=============================================================================
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler assigns surgeries to OR slots by quorum voting
among a scheduling committee, so that two surgeries can never both win the same
slot -- while the chief of surgery may still force an override.

A surgery requests a currently-free OR slot. A committee member grants its single
vote to a requested surgery-slot claim. A surgery that has collected a quorum of
grants for a free slot is assigned it through the normal path. The chief of surgery
may instead force-assign a slot, bypassing the quorum. A slot may be vacated,
clearing its assignment together with its votes and pending requests. A member may
withdraw its vote, but only while the voted slot is still unassigned, so a granted
assignment never loses its quorum backing.

The full set of actions is: request a free slot, grant a member's single vote to a
surgery-slot claim, assign a slot on a quorum, force-assign a slot as chief, vacate
a slot and clear its votes and requests, and withdraw a vote from an unassigned
slot.

SAFETY PROPERTY: any slot assigned through the normal path holds a quorum of
committee grants for the surgery it was assigned to, so two surgeries can never
both win the same slot, and only a chief's override is exempt.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od19m6p1t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Writers, MaxCap

NoOne == 0

Weight(w) == w

RECURSIVE SumOf(_)
SumOf(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN Weight(x) + SumOf(S \ {x})

VARIABLES record, committed, leaseHolder, capacity

vars == <<record, committed, leaseHolder, capacity>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ record \in 0..SumOf(Writers)
    /\ committed \in SUBSET Writers
    /\ leaseHolder \in Writers \union {NoOne}
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap

Init ==
    /\ record = 0
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ leaseHolder = NoOne
    /\ capacity = MaxCap

\* A librarian takes the exclusive update lease on the shared reservation record.
AcquireLease(w) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = NoOne
    /\ leaseHolder' = w
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, capacity>>

\* Only the current lease holder may commit its contribution into the record, and
\* only while it stays within the current capacity. The exclusive lease is what
\* keeps two concurrent updates from losing each other.
Commit(w) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = w
    /\ w \notin committed
    /\ record + Weight(w) <= capacity
    /\ record' = record + Weight(w)
    /\ committed' = committed \union {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, capacity>>

\* The lease holder releases the lease.
Release(w) ==
    /\ leaseHolder = w
    /\ leaseHolder' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, capacity>>

\* The lease times out at its deadline, freeing it for another writer.
Expire ==
    /\ leaseHolder # NoOne
    /\ leaseHolder' = NoOne
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, capacity>>

\* A committed contribution is removed (a reservation cancelled).
Remove(w) ==
    /\ w \in committed
    /\ record' = record - Weight(w)
    /\ committed' = committed \ {w}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaseHolder, capacity>>

\* The reservation record's capacity is re-rated at runtime.
Resize(c) ==
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<record, committed, leaseHolder>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Writers : AcquireLease(w)
    \/ \E w \in Writers : Commit(w)
    \/ \E w \in Writers : Release(w)
    \/ Expire
    \/ \E w \in Writers : Remove(w)
    \/ \E c \in 0..MaxCap : Resize(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: the shared record always equals exactly the sum of the weights
\* of the writers whose contributions are committed, so no committed contribution is
\* ever lost or double-counted -- the exclusive lease serialises the updates.
NoLostUpdate == record = SumOf(committed)

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od15m4p2t0 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Total, MaxQueue

VARIABLES available, queued, booked, filled, crashed

vars == <<available, queued, booked, filled, crashed>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ available \in 0..Total
    /\ queued \in 0..Total
    /\ booked \in 0..Total
    /\ filled \in 0..Total
    /\ crashed \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
    /\ available = Total
    /\ queued = 0
    /\ booked = 0
    /\ filled = 0
    /\ crashed = FALSE

\* An order lot is submitted into the bounded work queue; backpressure blocks the
\* submission when the queue is full.
Submit ==
    /\ available > 0
    /\ queued < MaxQueue
    /\ available' = available - 1
    /\ queued' = queued + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<booked, filled, crashed>>

\* The matching engine moves a queued order into the order book (blocked if the
\* engine has crashed).
Book ==
    /\ ~ crashed
    /\ queued > 0
    /\ queued' = queued - 1
    /\ booked' = booked + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<available, filled, crashed>>

\* A booked order is matched at the opening cross and becomes a fill.
Match ==
    /\ ~ crashed
    /\ booked > 0
    /\ booked' = booked - 1
    /\ filled' = filled + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<available, queued, crashed>>

\* A booked order is cancelled; its lot returns to the available pool.
Cancel ==
    /\ booked > 0
    /\ booked' = booked - 1
    /\ available' = available + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<queued, filled, crashed>>

\* The matching engine crashes silently; it processes nothing until it recovers,
\* but no lot is lost.
Crash ==
    /\ ~ crashed
    /\ crashed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<available, queued, booked, filled>>

Recover ==
    /\ crashed
    /\ crashed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<available, queued, booked, filled>>

Next ==
    \/ Submit
    \/ Book
    \/ Match
    \/ Cancel
    \/ Crash
    \/ Recover

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: every share lot is always accounted for in exactly one of the four
\* stages -- available, queued, booked, or filled -- so the auction pipeline never
\* creates or loses a lot, even when the matching engine crashes silently.
Conserved == available + queued + booked + filled = Total

    /\ pendingShed \in 0..Total
    /\ shed \in 0..Total
    /\ overrides \in 0..MaxOv

Init ==
    /\ onGrid = Total
    /\ pendingShed = 0
    /\ shed = 0
    /\ overrides = 0

\* A shed command is queued into the bounded work queue; backpressure blocks it
\* when the queue is full. The load unit moves from the grid into the pending queue.
Enqueue ==
    /\ onGrid > 0
    /\ pendingShed < MaxQueue
    /\ onGrid' = onGrid - 1
    /\ pendingShed' = pendingShed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shed, overrides>>

\* A queued shed command is executed, moving its load unit into the shed pool.
Process ==
    /\ pendingShed > 0
    /\ pendingShed' = pendingShed - 1
    /\ shed' = shed + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<onGrid, overrides>>

\* Shed load is restored back onto the grid.
Restore ==
    /\ shed > 0
    /\ shed' = shed - 1
    /\ onGrid' = onGrid + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pendingShed, overrides>>

\* A queued shed command is cancelled; its load unit returns to the grid.
Cancel ==
    /\ pendingShed > 0
    /\ pendingShed' = pendingShed - 1
    /\ onGrid' = onGrid + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<shed, overrides>>

\* A privileged grid admin force-sheds a load unit directly, bypassing the queue.
AdminOverride ==
    /\ onGrid > 0
    /\ onGrid' = onGrid - 1
    /\ shed' = shed + 1
    /\ overrides' = (overrides + 1) % (MaxOv + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED pendingShed

Next ==
    \/ Enqueue
    \/ Process
    \/ Restore
    \/ Cancel
    \/ AdminOverride

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Conservation: every load unit is always accounted for in exactly one of the three
\* places -- on the grid, queued to be shed, or already shed -- so the shedder never
\* creates or loses a unit of load, not even under an admin override.
Conserved == onGrid + pendingShed + shed = Total

=============================================================================

    MaxQueue = 2
    MaxOv = 2

A power-grid load shedder pipelines a fixed pool of load units between the grid and

administrator may force-shed a load unit directly, bypassing the queue.

The full set of actions is: enqueue a shed command under backpressure, process a
queued command into the shed pool, restore shed load to the grid, cancel a queued
command back to the grid, and perform a privileged admin force-shed.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every load unit is always accounted for in exactly one of the
three places -- on the grid, queued to be shed, or already shed -- so the shedder
never creates or loses a unit of load, not even under an admin override.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od16m5p3t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Pharmacists, Prescriptions, NumBays, Quorum

Bays == 1..NumBays
NoOne == "no_one"
NoPresc == "no_presc"
NoBay == 0
NoGrant == <<NoPresc, NoBay>>

VARIABLES granted, requesting, occupied, capacity

vars == <<granted, requesting, occupied, capacity>>

Tally(pr, b) == Cardinality({ph \in Pharmacists : granted[ph] = <<pr, b>>})

TypeOK ==
    /\ granted \in [Pharmacists -> (Prescriptions \union {NoPresc}) \X (Bays \union {NoBay})]
    /\ requesting \in SUBSET (Prescriptions \X Bays)
    /\ occupied \in [Bays -> Prescriptions \union {NoOne}]
    /\ capacity \in 1..NumBays

Init ==
    /\ granted = [ph \in Pharmacists |-> NoGrant]
    /\ requesting = {}
    /\ occupied = [b \in Bays |-> NoOne]
    /\ capacity = NumBays

\* A prescription requests a currently-free, active dispensing bay.
Request(pr, b) ==
    /\ b <= capacity
    /\ occupied[b] = NoOne
    /\ <<pr, b>> \notin requesting
    /\ requesting' = requesting \union {<<pr, b>>}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, occupied, capacity>>

\* A pharmacist grants its single vote to a requested prescription-bay claim.
Vote(ph, pr, b) ==
    /\ <<pr, b>> \in requesting
    /\ occupied[b] = NoOne
    /\ b <= capacity
    /\ granted[ph] = NoGrant
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![ph] = <<pr, b>>]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<requesting, occupied, capacity>>

\* A prescription with a quorum of grants for a free bay is assigned it.
Assign(pr, b) ==
    /\ occupied[b] = NoOne
    /\ Tally(pr, b) >= Quorum
    /\ occupied' = [occupied EXCEPT ![b] = pr]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, requesting, capacity>>

\* A bay is vacated, clearing its assignment together with its votes and requests.
Vacate(b) ==
    /\ occupied[b] # NoOne
    /\ occupied' = [occupied EXCEPT ![b] = NoOne]
    /\ granted' = [ph \in Pharmacists |->
                     IF granted[ph] # NoGrant /\ granted[ph][2] = b THEN NoGrant ELSE granted[ph]]
    /\ requesting' = {r \in requesting : r[2] # b}
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

\* A pharmacist withdraws its vote, only while the voted bay is still unassigned.
Withdraw(ph) ==
    /\ granted[ph] # NoGrant
    /\ occupied[granted[ph][2]] = NoOne
    /\ granted' = [granted EXCEPT ![ph] = NoGrant]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<requesting, occupied, capacity>>

\* The number of active dispensing bays is re-rated at runtime.
Resize(c) ==
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<granted, requesting, occupied>>

Next ==
    \/ \E pr \in Prescriptions, b \in Bays : Request(pr, b)
    \/ \E ph \in Pharmacists, pr \in Prescriptions, b \in Bays : Vote(ph, pr, b)
    \/ \E pr \in Prescriptions, b \in Bays : Assign(pr, b)
    \/ \E b \in Bays : Vacate(b)
    \/ \E ph \in Pharmacists : Withdraw(ph)
    \/ \E c \in 1..NumBays : Resize(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation via quorum: for any bay, no two distinct prescriptions can
\* simultaneously hold a quorum of pharmacist grants, so two prescriptions can never
\* both be dispensed into the same bay.
NoDoubleAlloc ==
    \A b \in Bays :
        \A p1 \in Prescriptions, p2 \in Prescriptions :
            (p1 # p2 /\ Tally(p1, b) >= Quorum /\ Tally(p2, b) >= Quorum) => FALSE

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Pharmacists = {"ph1", "ph2"}
    Prescriptions = {"rx1", "rx2"}
    NumBays = 2
    Quorum = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoDoubleAlloc
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser assigns prescriptions to dispensing bays by
quorum voting among the on-duty pharmacists, so that two prescriptions can never
both be dispensed into the same bay. The number of active dispensing bays is
re-rated at runtime.

A prescription requests a currently-free, active dispensing bay. A pharmacist grants
its single vote to a requested prescription-bay claim. A prescription that has
collected a quorum of grants for a free bay is assigned it. A bay is vacated,
clearing its assignment together with its votes and pending requests. A pharmacist
may withdraw its vote, but only while the voted bay is still unassigned, so a
granted assignment never loses its quorum backing. The number of active bays may be
re-rated to a new value at runtime.

The full set of actions is: request a free active bay, grant a pharmacist's single
vote to a prescription-bay claim, assign a bay on a quorum, vacate a bay and clear
its votes and requests, withdraw a vote from an unassigned bay, and resize the
active-bay count.

SAFETY PROPERTY: for any bay, no two distinct prescriptions can simultaneously hold
a quorum of pharmacist grants, so two prescriptions can never both be dispensed into
the same bay.
