------------------------------ MODULE W4Od7m9p4t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Cranes, MaxCap, MaxEpoch

NoEpoch == 0 - 1

VARIABLES epoch, capacity, placed, inflight, craneEpoch

vars == <<epoch, capacity, placed, inflight, craneEpoch>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ capacity \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ placed \in 0..MaxCap
    /\ inflight \in SUBSET Cranes
    /\ craneEpoch \in [Cranes -> (0..MaxEpoch) \union {NoEpoch}]

Init ==
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ capacity = MaxCap
    /\ placed = 0
    /\ inflight = {}
    /\ craneEpoch = [c \in Cranes |-> NoEpoch]

\* The yard is reconfigured under a new epoch, re-rating capacity at runtime, never
\* below what is already placed.
Reconfig ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ \E cap \in 1..MaxCap :
        /\ cap >= placed
        /\ capacity' = cap
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<placed, inflight, craneEpoch>>

\* A crane requests a placement, stamping its authorization with the current epoch;
\* the commit message goes in flight and may be processed out of order.
RequestPlace(c) ==
    /\ c \notin inflight
    /\ placed < capacity
    /\ craneEpoch' = [craneEpoch EXCEPT ![c] = epoch]
    /\ inflight' = inflight \union {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, placed>>

\* A place commit is processed (in whatever order it surfaces), but only if its
\* authorization is still current for this epoch and there is genuine room now.
ConfirmPlace(c) ==
    /\ c \in inflight
    /\ craneEpoch[c] = epoch
    /\ placed < capacity
    /\ placed' = placed + 1
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, craneEpoch>>

\* A commit whose authorization was issued under a superseded epoch is rejected.
StaleReject(c) ==
    /\ c \in inflight
    /\ craneEpoch[c] # epoch
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, placed, craneEpoch>>

\* A container is retrieved from the yard, freeing capacity.
Retrieve ==
    /\ placed > 0
    /\ placed' = placed - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, capacity, inflight, craneEpoch>>

Next ==
    \/ Reconfig
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : RequestPlace(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : ConfirmPlace(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cranes : StaleReject(c)
    \/ Retrieve

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity: the number of containers placed in the yard never exceeds the
\* current capacity, even across a runtime epoch reconfiguration, because a commit
\* authorized under a stale epoch is rejected and every commit re-checks for room.
WithinCapacity == placed <= capacity

=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
    Cranes = {"c1", "c2"}
    MaxCap = 3
    MaxEpoch = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
A container-ship crane yard has a bounded number of container spaces whose capacity
is managed by epoch-numbered reconfiguration. Cranes place containers under
authorizations stamped with the current epoch, and place-commit messages travel
over a network that may process them out of order, so the yard is never overfilled.

The yard is reconfigured under a new epoch, re-rating capacity at runtime but never
below what is already placed. A crane requests a placement, stamping its
authorization with the current epoch; the commit message goes in flight and may be
processed in a different order than others. When a place commit is processed, it
increments the yard count only if its authorization is still current for this epoch
and there is genuine room now. A commit whose authorization was issued under a
superseded epoch is rejected. A container may be retrieved from the yard, freeing
capacity.

The full set of actions is: reconfigure capacity under a new epoch, request a
placement with an epoch-stamped authorization (commit in flight), process a place
commit out of order under the epoch and capacity checks, reject a stale commit, and
retrieve a container.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of containers placed in the yard never exceeds the
current capacity, even across a runtime epoch reconfiguration, because a commit
authorized under a stale epoch is rejected and every commit re-checks for room.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od14m0p1t4 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Drones, Sectors, MaxVer

NoSnap == 0 - 1

VARIABLES recorded, confirmed, version, snap, capacity

vars == <<recorded, confirmed, version, snap, capacity>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ recorded \in SUBSET Sectors
    /\ confirmed \in SUBSET Sectors
    /\ version \in 0..MaxVer
    /\ snap \in [Drones -> (0..MaxVer) \union {NoSnap}]
    /\ capacity \in 0..Cardinality(Sectors)

Init ==
    /\ recorded = {}
    /\ confirmed = {}
    /\ version = 0
    /\ snap = [d \in Drones |-> NoSnap]
    /\ capacity = Cardinality(Sectors)

\* A drone optimistically reads the coverage-map version before claiming a sector.
Read(d) ==
    /\ snap[d] = NoSnap
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = version]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recorded, confirmed, version, capacity>>

\* The drone commits a new sector into coverage only if the version is unchanged
\* since its read (optimistic check) and coverage is within the current capacity.
\* The sector is written to both the fast map and the durable record together.
Commit(d, sec) ==
    /\ snap[d] = version
    /\ sec \notin recorded
    /\ Cardinality(recorded) < capacity
    /\ recorded' = recorded \union {sec}
    /\ confirmed' = confirmed \union {sec}
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED capacity

\* If the version moved under it, the drone discards its stale read and retries.
Retry(d) ==
    /\ snap[d] # NoSnap
    /\ snap[d] # version
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![d] = NoSnap]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recorded, confirmed, version, capacity>>

\* Coverage of a sector is dropped from both the fast map and the durable record.
Uncover(sec) ==
    /\ sec \in confirmed
    /\ recorded' = recorded \ {sec}
    /\ confirmed' = confirmed \ {sec}
    /\ version' = (version + 1) % (MaxVer + 1)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<snap, capacity>>

\* The coverage capacity is re-rated at runtime; it never evicts existing coverage.
Resize(c) ==
    /\ capacity' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<recorded, confirmed, version, snap>>

Next ==
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Read(d)
    \/ \E d \in Drones, sec \in Sectors : Commit(d, sec)
    \/ \E d \in Drones : Retry(d)
    \/ \E sec \in Sectors : Uncover(sec)
    \/ \E c \in 0..Cardinality(Sectors) : Resize(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: every durably-confirmed sector coverage is always present in the
\* fast coverage map that drones read, so no confirmed coverage is ever lost from the
\* map -- not even when the capacity is re-rated down at runtime.
NoLostUpdate == confirmed \subseteq recorded

=============================================================================
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm maintains a shared sector-coverage map. Drones
add sectors to coverage using optimistic locking with retry against a
version-stamped map, so that no confirmed coverage is ever lost. The coverage
capacity is re-rated at runtime.

A drone optimistically reads the coverage-map version before claiming a sector. It
commits a new sector into coverage only if the version is unchanged since its read
-- the optimistic check -- and coverage is within the current capacity; on commit
the sector is written to both the fast map and the durable record together. If the
version moved under it, the drone discards its stale read and retries. Coverage of a
sector may be dropped from both the fast map and the durable record. The coverage
capacity may be re-rated to a new value at runtime, and doing so never evicts
existing coverage.

The full set of actions is: optimistically read the version, commit a new sector
under the optimistic and capacity checks, retry after a stale read, uncover a
sector from both records, and resize the capacity.

SAFETY PROPERTY: every durably-confirmed sector coverage is always present in the
fast coverage map that drones read, so no confirmed coverage is ever lost from the
map, not even when the capacity is re-rated down at runtime.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od19m2p1t2 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Items

NoItem == "no_item"

VARIABLES committed, viewA, viewB, txItem, phase, txOp

vars == <<committed, viewA, viewB, txItem, phase, txOp>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ committed \in SUBSET Items
    /\ viewA \in SUBSET Items
    /\ viewB \in SUBSET Items
    /\ txItem \in Items \union {NoItem}
    /\ phase \in {"idle", "prepared", "committing"}
    /\ txOp \in {"add", "remove", "none"}

Init ==
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ viewA = {}
    /\ viewB = {}
    /\ txItem = NoItem
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ txOp = "none"

\* Begin a two-phase update: add a not-yet-committed item, or remove a committed one.
Begin(i, op) ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ (op = "add" => i \notin committed)
    /\ (op = "remove" => i \in committed)
    /\ phase' = "prepared"
    /\ txItem' = i
    /\ txOp' = op
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, viewA, viewB>>

\* Commit updates the master committed set and moves to propagation.
Commit ==
    /\ phase = "prepared"
    /\ committed' = IF txOp = "add" THEN committed \union {txItem} ELSE committed \ {txItem}
    /\ phase' = "committing"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<viewA, viewB, txItem, txOp>>

\* Instance A applies the committed change into its own shared view.
ApplyA ==
    /\ phase = "committing"
    /\ (txItem \in viewA) # (txItem \in committed)
    /\ viewA' = IF txOp = "add" THEN viewA \union {txItem} ELSE viewA \ {txItem}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, viewB, txItem, phase, txOp>>

\* Instance B applies the committed change into its own shared view.
ApplyB ==
    /\ phase = "committing"
    /\ (txItem \in viewB) # (txItem \in committed)
    /\ viewB' = IF txOp = "add" THEN viewB \union {txItem} ELSE viewB \ {txItem}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, viewA, txItem, phase, txOp>>

\* Once both instances have applied the change, the transaction settles.
Finish ==
    /\ phase = "committing"
    /\ (txItem \in viewA) = (txItem \in committed)
    /\ (txItem \in viewB) = (txItem \in committed)
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ txItem' = NoItem
    /\ txOp' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, viewA, viewB>>

\* A prepared transaction may abort, changing nothing.
Abort ==
    /\ phase = "prepared"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ txItem' = NoItem
    /\ txOp' = "none"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<committed, viewA, viewB>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Items, op \in {"add", "remove"} : Begin(i, op)
    \/ Commit
    \/ ApplyA
    \/ ApplyB
    \/ Finish
    \/ Abort

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: whenever the protocol is settled (idle), both instances' shared
\* views exactly match the committed reservation set, so no committed update is ever
\* left dropped at one of the two instances once its transaction has completed.
SettledCoherent ==
    (phase = "idle") => (viewA = committed /\ viewB = committed)

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    Items = {"x", "y"}
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT SettledCoherent
nl:
A library book reservation system is served by two independent instances that
share one common pool of reservations. Each instance keeps its own view of the
reservation set, and updates are applied with a two-phase commit so that a
committed update is never lost or left applied at only one of the two instances.

A two-phase update begins by adding a not-yet-committed item, or removing a
committed one. Commit updates the master committed set and moves the protocol into
propagation, where each instance applies the committed change into its own shared
view. Once both instances have applied the change, the transaction settles. A
prepared transaction may instead abort, changing nothing.

The full set of actions is: begin an add or remove, commit the change to the master
set, apply the change at instance A, apply the change at instance B, finish once
both have applied, and abort a prepared transaction.

SAFETY PROPERTY: whenever the protocol is settled and idle, both instances' shared
views exactly match the committed reservation set, so no committed update is ever
left dropped at one of the two instances once its transaction has completed.

------------------------------ MODULE W4Od3m1p1t1 ------------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS NumBanks

Banks == 1..NumBanks
NextOf(b) == (b % NumBanks) + 1
Weight(b) == b

RECURSIVE SumOf(_)
SumOf(S) ==
    IF S = {} THEN 0
    ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN Weight(x) + SumOf(S \ {x})

VARIABLES token, ledger, committed, inflight

vars == <<token, ledger, committed, inflight>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Banks
    /\ ledger \in 0..SumOf(Banks)
    /\ committed \in SUBSET Banks
    /\ inflight \in SUBSET Banks

Init ==
    /\ token = 1
    /\ ledger = 0
    /\ committed = {}
    /\ inflight = {}

\* The settlement token circulates around the ring of banks.
PassToken ==
    /\ token' = NextOf(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, committed, inflight>>

\* Only the current token holder submits its settlement entry; the confirmation
\* message goes in flight and may be applied out of order.
Submit(b) ==
    /\ token = b
    /\ b \notin committed
    /\ b \notin inflight
    /\ inflight' = inflight \union {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, ledger, committed>>

\* A confirmation is applied (in whatever order it surfaces), posting the bank's
\* weight into the shared ledger and marking it committed together.
Apply(b) ==
    /\ b \in inflight
    /\ ledger' = ledger + Weight(b)
    /\ committed' = committed \union {b}
    /\ inflight' = inflight \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED token

\* A committed settlement is reversed, removing its weight from the ledger.
Reverse(b) ==
    /\ b \in committed
    /\ ledger' = ledger - Weight(b)
    /\ committed' = committed \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, inflight>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Submit(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Apply(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Reverse(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost updates: the shared ledger always equals exactly the sum of the weights
\* of the banks whose settlements are committed, so no committed settlement is ever
\* lost or double-posted -- even as confirmations are applied out of order.
NoLostUpdate == ledger = SumOf(committed)

=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
    NumBanks = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch posts each bank's settlement into one shared
ledger. A single settlement token circulates around a ring of banks, and only the
bank holding the token may submit its settlement, so that no committed settlement is
ever lost. Confirmation messages travel over a network that may apply them out of
order.

The settlement token circulates around the ring of banks. Only the current token
holder submits its settlement entry, putting a confirmation message in flight that
may be applied in a different order than others. When a confirmation is applied, the
bank's weight is posted into the shared ledger and the bank is marked committed
together. A committed settlement may be reversed, removing its weight from the
ledger.

The full set of actions is: pass the settlement token, submit an entry as the token
holder (confirmation in flight), apply a confirmation out of order into the ledger,
and reverse a committed settlement.

SAFETY PROPERTY: the shared ledger always equals exactly the sum of the weights of
the banks whose settlements are committed, so no committed settlement is ever lost
or double-posted, even as confirmations are applied out of order.
